intro.fr: Bugs Bunny Lost in Time se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Bugs Bunny Lost in Time can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Behaviour Interactive sort Bugs Bunny Lost in Time en 1999.
text.en: Behaviour Interactive releases Bugs Bunny Lost in Time in 1999.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub SynthKat67/BugsBunnylitAPWorld, qui héberge l'APWorld de Bugs Bunny Lost in Time.
text.en: The GitHub repository SynthKat67/BugsBunnylitAPWorld, home of the Bugs Bunny Lost in Time APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v.0.2.0, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v.0.2.0 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Bugs Bunny Lost in Time figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Bugs Bunny Lost in Time is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
